name: io.github.linq2db/linq2db.cli
title: LINQ to DB
description: Inspect database schemas and execute SQL queries across multiple database providers with LINQ to DB.

packageArguments.name: --config
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to a local linq2db query/MCP configuration file containing database profiles.

packageArguments.name: --profile
packageArguments.description: Default database profile from the configuration file.

packageArguments.name: --enable-execute-tool
packageArguments.description: Register the write-capable tool. Execution also requires enableExecute=true in the selected profile.
